question.text: Select the correct statement(s) about cimetidine andranitidine.

options.text: These prevent the excess production of  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></math>  inthe stomach
Both prevent the interaction between histamineand receptor of stomach wall
All of the above are correct statements

solution.text:
A Both are antihistamine drugs.
B and C They prevent the interaction of histamine with the receptors present in the stomach wall and thus lesser HCl is formed.
